reason: I like the idea of keeping the 18% but I'm not going to pay $800 to a studio to move my guests off Booking.com. Guests trust Booking.com more than my own website, and the ones who find me on Instagram still look for the reviews before they pay anything.
objection: Will guests actually book on my own page when Booking.com is where they already feel safe? And the $650 is commission I'd save only if the bookings really come direct, plus I'd have to pay for the booking engine on top.
would_change_my_mind: A guesthouse like mine showing me real direct bookings coming in each month, with the figures, before I spend anything.
